lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Distinct grid of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the pectoral fin, arranged in near-vertical columns and horizontal rows. Spacing between centroids increases toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical white lines intersect with horizontal rows of high-intensity blobs, forming clear rectangular grid nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with specular highlights on the upper edge and defined shadowing on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits approximately 10-12 discrete, high-luminance spots of irregular sizes distributed across the mid and anterior sections of the fin's macro-mask.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region exhibits a transition from dense, labyrinthine vermiculated lines into discrete circular blobs moving posteriorly toward the gills.
